dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We came to see him as well.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: If he knew you came... Well, he certainly wouldn't say it, but it'd make him happy.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You stand together with Illuga before the grave for a while...\nIlluga speaks to your fallen comrade, recounting the small and big events that have taken place in Piramida lately...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He can finally rest in peace knowing that everyone in Piramida's doing well, right?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yes. He completed his mission. We will continue with ours.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And after us, others will continue to watch over this land. Like the Winter Icelea, they will endure storms and cold, yet still grow strong.
